name: Robin Cozad
occupation: Business owner in the Cheyenne area, including the Mongolian Grill, a towing company, a car lot, a stock shop, and a sewer company (statement reported by the Wyoming Tribune Eagle, Sept. 23, 2026)
military: U.S. Navy (statement reported by the Wyoming Tribune Eagle, Sept. 23, 2026)
background: Robin Cozad was the Democratic nominee for Laramie County sheriff in 2026 and lost the November 3 general election to incumbent Brian Kozak. The Wyoming Tribune Eagle reported on a September 2026 town hall that Cozad said he does not have much law-enforcement experience, that he worked for the Redding Police Department in Redding, California, 'a long, long time ago,' that he served in the United States Navy, and that he owns and runs several Cheyenne-area businesses, including the Mongolian Grill, a towing company, a car lot, a stock shop, and a sewer company.
